question: A wire of fixed length $L$ carries a steady current $I$. It is first bent to form a circular coil of 1 turn. The same wire is then rewound to form a circular coil of 3 turns. Calculate the ratio of the magnetic fields at the center in the two cases ($B_{1\text{ turn}} : B_{3\text{ turns}}$).
